rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks to turn existing host_a and host_b dialogue into a transcript and escaped two-voice speech markup. Use the PodcastDialogueFormatter tool on the sample.
cases.local_answer:
I ran the PodcastDialogueFormatter on its bundled sample. It returned a two-line transcript and two-voice SSML. No audio was generated.

**Transcript**
```
host_a: Today we are exploring Contoso's fictional planning notebook.
host_b: A small shared note can make a handoff clearer.
```

**Speech markup (SSML)**
```xml
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural">Today we are exploring Contoso's fictional planning notebook.</voice><voice name="en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural">A small shared note can make a handoff clearer.</voice></speak>
```

**Voice mapping:** host_a uses en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural, and host_b uses en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural.

The tool used its own sample, not your host_a and host_b dialogue. If you paste your dialogue as host_a/host_b turns, I can format that instead.
